The project has been set up in your working folder. Your goal is to find errors and inconsistencies in the sources and family structure recorded for Jean Baptiste Moreau, who was born on 12 March 1821 and died on 3 October 1889, both in Bastogne in the Belgian province of Luxembourg.

---

### What the data integrity check found

All four people in the family — Jean Baptiste, Marie Dubois, Henri, and Josephine — passed the automated checks cleanly. No dates are impossible and no parent-child age gaps fall outside the normal range. Jean Baptiste was about 27 when Henri was born and about 30 when Josephine was born; Marie Dubois was about 23 and 26 respectively. All of that is unremarkable.

---

### Structural problems worth investigating

**Missing marriage or partnership record.** Marie Dubois is recorded as the mother of both children alongside Jean Baptiste, but there is no marriage or couple relationship linking the two of them in the tree at all. Two people who share children but have no recorded union is a red flag — either a marriage record was never attached, or the parentage assignments were made independently and may not be reliable. Finding and attaching a marriage record is the most important next step.

**Inconsistent relationship labels between the two children.** Jean Baptiste's relationship to Henri is labeled "Biological," but his relationship to Josephine carries no label at all. The same inconsistency appears on Marie Dubois's side. This could simply be a data entry oversight, or it could hint that Josephine's parentage was entered differently — perhaps from a different source — and is worth checking.

A death record from that same collection almost certainly exists and would name the informant, confirm his age and place, and possibly name relatives. It has not been attached.

**The 1866 census covers the household but is only attached to Jean Baptiste.** If this record documents his household, it very likely includes Marie Dubois (then about 41) and the children Henri (about 18) and Josephine (about 15). None of them have it attached to their profiles.

**Two sources for the same birth event have not been compared.** Jean Baptiste has both a civil registration entry and a church baptism record for his birth. These sometimes agree and sometimes differ on the exact date or the parents' names. Neither has been checked against the other.

No parents are recorded for Jean Baptiste or for Marie Dubois — an entire generation is missing. Marie Dubois has no death date or place recorded. Henri and Josephine each have only a birth record; nothing is known about their later lives.

A small place-name note: "Bastogne, Luxembourg" as written could be read as the country of Luxembourg rather than the Belgian province of Luxembourg. Your overall goal is a source and family structure audit, so the first research question to tackle is the most pressing gap: **was there a recorded marriage between Jean Baptiste Moreau and Marie Dubois in Bastogne?** Answering that would either confirm the family unit or expose a problem with the parentage assignments.
